name: Bespoke
zh_summary: During the Dot Com Crash, stocks not tied to the Internet and mobile buildout performed well. From the end of 1999 to the end of 2001, the S&P 500 Equal Weight index rose 5%.
en_summary: During the Dot Com Crash, stocks not tied to the Internet and mobile buildout performed well. From the end of 1999 to the end of 2001, the S&P 500 Equal Weight index rose 5%.
text:
An often overlooked aspect of the Dot Com Crash is that stocks not tied to the Internet and mobile buildout did quite well for a long stretch.

From the end of 1999 to the end of 2001, the S&P 500 Equal Weight index not only didn’t fall, it was up 5%.  $SPY $RSP
